#### Fns of `hub`

- `hub/fns_load`: Add fns to your tools for the rest of this chat, by their names: each becomes a tool you can call from your next step. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    fns: list<text{pattern="^[a-z]\\S*$"}>{minLength=1}
  }) => obj{ loaded, refused, cards … }
  ```
- `hub/fns_drop`: Remove fns from your tools. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    fns: list<text{pattern="^[a-z]\\S*$"}>{minLength=1}
  }) => obj{dropped: list<text>}
  ```
- `hub/fns_search`: Search fns in the hub by words, meaning or both, best first or by name, filtered by system, instance, who shares them, the types they read or write and their mode, a page at a time. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{ text?, kinds?, systems?, instance?, visibility?, types?, modes?, effects?, names?, available?, niches?, order?, offset?, limit? … }) => obj{ items, next?, filtered?, loaded?, missing? … }
  ```
- `hub/ctx_search`: Search context (guides, memories, pieces of files) by words or meaning, a page at a time. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{ text?, systems?, origins?, scopes?, tags?, names?, niches?, order?, offset?, limit? … }) => obj{ items, next?, filtered?, loaded?, missing? … }
  ```
- `hub/fns_examples`: A page of one fn's example calls (its args, the result when kept, and what each shows), the closest to what you are about to do first. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    /* A fn's name, as your tools spell it. */ fn: text{pattern="^[a-z]\\S*$"},
    query?: text,
    offset?: num{whole=true, min=0},
    limit?: num{whole=true, min=1, max=50}
  }) => obj{
    fn: text,
    items: list<obj{args: any, result?: any, note?: text, /* fnExample id */ id: text, rank?: num}>,
    total: num{whole=true, min=0},
    next?: num{whole=true, min=0}
  }
  ```
- `hub/fns_get`: One fn as the hub keeps it: its kind, description, instructions, payload (for a fn of a kind), version and where it runs. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{fn: text{pattern="^[a-z]\\S*$"}}) => obj{ fn, kind, description, instructions?, payload?, version, owner?, routing?, available, blocked?, args?, returns?, live? … }
  ```
- `hub/fns_save`: Keep a fn of one of the calling system's kinds in the hub (a saved form, a saved query), owned by the run's person and shared as asked. Saving a name again keeps the old version in its history. Tags: `own`.

  ```text
  (obj{ kind, name, description, instructions?, payload, examples?, tags?, share?, routing?, replace? … }) => obj{fn: text{pattern="^[a-z]\\S*$"}, version: num{min=1, whole=true}, created: bool}
  ```
- `hub/fns_remove`: Remove a fn of one of the calling system's kinds that a person saved (a saved form, a saved query): it is no longer listed, called or run. The hub keeps its versions, and undoing the run brings back the version it had. Tags: `own`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    /* The fn to remove, by its name. */ fn: text{pattern="^[a-z]\\S*$"}
  }) => obj{fn: text{pattern="^[a-z]\\S*$"}, version: num{min=1, whole=true}}
  ```
- `hub/ctx_load`: Load context items (guides, memories, pieces of files) into this chat by their full names: their text is in your prompt from your next step, with what they import, and the fns they bring join your tools. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{context: list<text>{minLength=1}}) => obj{ loaded, fns, fnsRefused, refused, cards … }
  ```
- `hub/ctx_drop`: Take context items out of this chat: their text leaves your prompt from your next step. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{context: list<text>{minLength=1}}) => obj{dropped: list<text>}
  ```
- `hub/ctx_crawl`: Gather the context a task needs by following context links from starting keys, a level at a time, with the decision model choosing which links to follow. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    context: list<text{minLength=1}>,
    guidance: text{minLength=1, maxLength=4000},
    maxDepth?: num{whole=true, min=0, max=10},
    maxDecisions?: num{whole=true, min=1, max=4096},
    maxTokens?: num{whole=true, min=1, max=1000000},
    metadataOnly?: bool
  }) => obj{ loaded, fns, fnsRefused, refused, cards, crawled, skipped, stop, depth, decisions, tokens, calls, metadataOnly … }
  ```
- `hub/search_resources`: Search files and other resources by meaning and words. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    query: text,
    roots?: list<text>,
    limit?: num{min=1, max=50, whole=true}
  }) => list<obj{uri: text, section?: text, title: text, preview: text, rank: num}>
  ```
- `hub/run_status`: The status of one run (one call of a fn): running, waiting (for approval or for a form), done with its result, failed with its error, or cancelled, with its progress. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{run: text}) => obj{
    status: enum<text>{
      "awaiting-approval",
      queued,
      running,
      waiting,
      paused,
      done,
      "invalid-input",
      failed,
      cancelled,
      undone
    },
    progress?: any,
    result?: any,
    error?: obj{
      class: enum<text>{retry, caller, fatal},
      message: text,
      code?: text,
      data?: any
    }
  }
  ```
- `hub/run_wait`: Wait for one run (such as a call that went to the background) to finish, up to a timeout, and give its result. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    run: text,
    /* How long to wait, in milliseconds (30000 is 30 seconds). Leave empty to wait as long as this call may run. */ timeout?: duration
  }) => obj{
    status: enum<text>{
      "awaiting-approval",
      queued,
      running,
      waiting,
      paused,
      done,
      "invalid-input",
      failed,
      cancelled,
      undone
    },
    result?: any,
    error?: obj{
      class: enum<text>{retry, caller, fatal},
      message: text,
      code?: text,
      data?: any
    }
  }
  ```
- `hub/ask_user`: Ask a person one plain question and wait for their answer: your call stays open until they reply, and the reply is its result. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{question: text, user?: text}) => obj{answer: text}
  ```
- `hub/inspect`: Look at one item by its full name, at a detail: a fn's card, a context item's text, a type's definition, or a resource's outline. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    name: text{pattern="^[a-z]\\S*$"},
    detail?: enum<text>{listed, signature, full}
  }) => obj{
    name: text,
    kind: enum<text>{fn, context, resource, type},
    detail: enum<text>{listed, signature, full},
    text: text
  }
  ```
- `hub/load`: Keep fns (as cards) and context items (as text) in your prompt from the next step on, by their full names. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    names: list<text{pattern="^[a-z]\\S*$"}>{minLength=1},
    detail?: enum<text>{listed, signature, full}
  }) => obj{ loaded, refused … }
  ```
- `hub/unload`: Take fns and context out of what you keep in front of you. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    names: list<text{pattern="^[a-z]\\S*$"}>{minLength=1}
  }) => obj{
    unloaded: list<text>,
    refused: list<obj{name: text, reason: text}>
  }
  ```
- `hub/resource_outline`: A resource's sections (headings, symbols, pages or tables), each with its key and place in the outline. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{uri: text}) => list<obj{
    key: text{minLength=1},
    path: list<text>,
    title: text,
    start: num{whole=true, min=0},
    end: num{whole=true, min=0},
    embedText?: text,
    form?: enum<text>{markdown, text, code, pages, table, description, ocr, transcript, thumbnail}
  }>
  ```
- `hub/resource_send`: Show yourself a resource (or one section of it) as it is, at your next step: an image you can see, audio, a PDF page or text. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{uri: text, section?: text{minLength=1}}) => obj{
    parts: list<obj{
      type: enum<text>{text, image, file, audio, video},
      name?: text,
      chars: num{whole=true, min=0}
    }>
  }
  ```
- `hub/image_read`: Ask a question about an image you can't see: another model that can see images looks at it and answers. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    image: text,
    question: text{minLength=1, maxLength=2000}
  }) => obj{answer: text, model: text, image: obj{id: text, name: text}}
  ```
- `hub/system_calls`: Holds the model calls a system makes outside its own runs (hooks, timers, start-up, its own aeye), so they are charged to its budgets and show as its.

  ```text
  (obj) => obj
  ```
- `hub/mint_mcp_token`: Mint a short-lived token for a hub MCP, for a session this system starts (a Claude session, for one). Only a grantee system's runs may call it. Tags: `admin`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    /* mcp id */ mcp: text,
    label: text{minLength=1},
    ttl?: num{whole=true, min=1000}
  }) => obj{token: text, expiresAt: timestamp}
  ```
- `hub/resource_list`: List resources (files, pages, uploads) from every system and the hub, filtered, grouped and paged. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{ cursor?, limit?, search?, system?, family?, source?, under?, form?, missing?, group?, in?, query? … }) => obj{ items, cursor?, facets … }
  ```
- `hub/resource_read`: Read a resource as text: its primary form (markdown for pages, tables for spreadsheets, pages for a PDF) or a chosen form, whole or by sections. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    uri: text,
    form?: or<enum<text>{markdown, text, code, pages, table, description, ocr, transcript, thumbnail}, literal<text>{value="raw"}>,
    section?: text{minLength=1},
    offset?: num{whole=true, min=0},
    maxChars?: num{whole=true, min=1, max=200000},
    rows?: obj{table: text, from: num{whole=true, min=0}, to: num{whole=true, min=0}}
  }) => obj{ uri, form, text, offset, total, truncated, partial?, note?, forms, offers … }
  ```
- `hub/ctx_get`: One context item (a guide, skill, memory or piece of a resource) with its text and its links both ways. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{name: text}) => obj{ record, links, backlinks, text? … }
  ```
- `hub/types_get`: The definitions of named types and of every type they refer to, dependencies first. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{names: list<text>}) => obj{ types, missing … }
  ```
- `hub/runs_list`: Runs, newest first, filtered by fn, status, session or system. A member sees their own runs. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{ cursor?, limit?, query? … }) => obj{ items, cursor? … }
  ```
- `hub/run_get`: One run: its fn, args, status, result or error, cost and timings. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{/* run id */ run: text}) => obj{ id, fn, fnVersion, kind, system, instance?, parent?, root, turn, session?, key, actor, caller, connection?, llmCall?, toolCallId?, args, repairs?, test?, status, text?, outcome?, progress?, allowed, cost, totalCost, priority, background, attempt, errors, undo?, resume?, stateChanges, tokens?, createdAt, approvedAt?, startedAt?, endedAt? … }
  ```
- `hub/run_tree`: The tree of runs a turn made: each run with the runs it called. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{/* turn id */ turn: text}) => any
  ```
- `hub/llm_call`: One LLM call: its whole request and response, tokens, cost and timings. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{/* llmInteraction id */ id: text}) => obj{ id, turn, run, session?, system?, iteration, provider, model, request, response?, usage?, cost, status, error?, priority, selection?, modelCall?, queuedAt, startedAt?, firstTokenAt?, endedAt? … }
  ```
- `hub/model_calls`: Model calls of every kind (chat, embeddings, images, transcription, speech), newest first, with cost and timings. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{ cursor?, limit?, run?, query? … }) => obj{ items, cursor? … }
  ```
- `hub/fns_metrics`: How fns have been doing: runs, outcomes, retries, durations (p50, p95), queue waits, cost and tokens. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    fn?: text{pattern="^[a-z]\\S*$"},
    system?: text,
    days?: num{whole=true, min=1, max=365}
  }) => list<obj{ fn, system, from, to, runs, outcomes, p50?, p95?, averageQueued?, averageCost, cost, tokens, retries, lastRunAt? … }>
  ```
- `hub/sessions_list`: The person's chats (sessions), most recent first, each with its id, title and when it was last used. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{ cursor?, limit?, query? … }) => obj{
    items: list<obj{
      /* session id */ id: text,
      title: text,
      /* actor id */ owner: text,
      agent: text,
      status: enum<text>{idle, running, paused},
      createdAt: num{whole=true},
      updatedAt: num{whole=true},
      archived: bool
    }>,
    cursor?: text
  }
  ```
- `hub/session_messages`: A session's messages, newest first, paged backwards. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    cursor?: text,
    limit?: num{whole=true, min=1, max=200},
    /* session id */ session: text
  }) => obj{ items, cursor? … }
  ```
- `hub/systems_list`: Every system: whether it is connected, its version, instances and what it offers. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{ query? … }) => list<obj{ name, description, about?, status, enabled, version, manifestHash, defaultInstance?, actor, stage?, keyFingerprint, config?, installed?, host?, pairedAt?, pairedBy?, lastSeenAt?, address?, counts, instanceMode, needsConfig, configType?, configSecrets?, instances … }>
  ```
- `hub/system_get`: One system: its status, version, instances, config state and what it offers. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{system: text}) => obj{ name, description, about?, status, enabled, version, manifestHash, defaultInstance?, actor, stage?, keyFingerprint, config?, installed?, host?, pairedAt?, pairedBy?, lastSeenAt?, address?, counts, instanceMode, needsConfig, configType?, configSecrets?, instances … }
  ```
- `hub/system_fns`: A system's fns, with whether each can be used now and its running numbers. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{system: text}) => list<obj{ name, system, decl, version, origin, addedBy?, available, paused, disabled, stats, updatedAt … }>
  ```
- `hub/system_logs`: The end of a system's output, oldest first. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    system: text,
    limit?: num{whole=true, min=1, max=2000}
  }) => list<obj{
    at: num{whole=true},
    stream: enum<text>{stdout, stderr, hub},
    text: text
  }>
  ```
- `hub/model_roles`: Which model (and provider) the hub uses for each job: chat, transcription, dictation, speech, describing images, reading text in them. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj) => list<obj{ role, choice?, from, resolved? … }>
  ```
- `hub/model_limits`: Each model's context window, output limit, reasoning reserve and characters per token, with where each came from. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{model?: text}) => list<obj{ model, limits, sources, ratio … }>
  ```
- `hub/query`: Any list (resources, fns, runs, modelCalls, llmCalls, sessions, contexts, notifications, systems, types, graph, users, groups) by the query standard: free text, filters on the list's fields (is, in, >, <, between, empty, contains, ...), a sort and paging. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{ list, query? … }) => obj{
    items: list<any>,
    cursor?: text,
    sort: list<obj{field: text{minLength=1}, dir: enum<text>{asc, desc}}>,
    total?: num{whole=true, min=0},
    /* More rows than the hub reads at once: more may match; narrow the filters for a full answer. */ partial?: literal<bool>{value=true}
  }
  ```
- `hub/graph`: The graph of what systems add (fns, context, types, kinds, commands, components, providers) and how they connect: what brings, calls, reads, writes, creates or refers to what. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{ text?, filters?, systems?, external?, focus?, collapse?, limit? … }) => obj{ nodes, edges, more, total … }
  ```
- `hub/item_versions`: The version history of one item a system declared or added while running (a fn, type, context item, kind, command, component, provider, ...): each version's declaration, how it changed, and who saved it, newest first. Tags: `read`.

  ```text
  (obj{ cursor?, limit?, system, section, name … }) => obj{ items, cursor? … }
  ```
- `hub/resource_convert`: Make another form of a resource now (a document as markdown, a description of an image, the text read from an image, a transcript of audio); it may cost a model call.

  ```text
  (obj{
    uri: text,
    kind: enum<text>{markdown, text, code, pages, table, description, ocr, transcript, thumbnail}
  }) => obj{
    hash: text,
    kind: enum<text>{markdown, text, code, pages, table, description, ocr, transcript, thumbnail},
    converter: text{minLength=1},
    content: obj{hash: text, size: num{whole=true, min=0}, mime: text},
    chars: num{whole=true, min=0},
    tokens: num{whole=true, min=0},
    call?: text,
    createdAt: num{whole=true}
  }
  ```
- `hub/resource_import`: Import a URL or uploaded content as a hub resource, kept and converted by the hub. Tags: `own`.

  ```text
  (obj{
    url?: text,
    render?: enum<text>{auto, always, never},
    name?: or<text, text{minLength=1}>,
    folder?: text{minLength=1},
    content?: obj{hash: text, size: num{whole=true, min=0}, mime: text},
    path?: text
  }) => obj{ uri, system, stat, links, indexedVersion?, sectioner?, source?, raw?, forms?, primary?, seenAt … }
  ```
- `hub/resource_rename`: Rename a hub resource.

  ```text
  (obj{uri: text, name: text{minLength=1}}) => obj{ uri, system, stat, links, indexedVersion?, sectioner?, source?, raw?, forms?, primary?, seenAt … }
  ```
- `hub/resource_delete`: Delete a hub resource; says how many messages, context items and runs still point at it.

  ```text
  (obj{uri: text}) => obj{
    deleted: bool,
    referencedBy: num{whole=true, min=0}
  }
  ```
- `hub/ctx_from_resource`: Make context items from a resource (one per section, under an outline parent), or update the ones made before.

  ```text
  (obj{ uri, sections?, copy?, weight?, tags?, fns?, suggestFns?, command?, visible?, suggest? … }) => obj{created: list<text>, updated: list<text>, links: num{whole=true, min=0}}
  ```
- `hub/remember`: Keep a fact for later as a memory (a context item): for this chat, for the person in all their chats, or for everyone.

  ```text
  (obj{ text, title?, scope?, about?, weight?, summary?, tags?, fns?, suggestFns?, command?, visible?, suggest?, parent? … }) => obj{name: text}
  ```
- `hub/forget`: Forget a memory.

  ```text
  (obj{name: text}) => obj{ok: bool}
  ```
- `hub/session_create`: Start a chat session for the person, with an agent and the systems it may use.

  ```text
  (obj{
    agent?: text,
    systems?: or<list<text>, literal<text>{value="all"}>,
    title?: text
  }) => obj{ id, title, owner, agent, model?, mode?, contextor?, fnMode?, systems, instructions?, citations?, selection?, participants, forkOf?, fork?, tools, context, suggested?, announcedSystems?, citationsTold?, fixed?, status, transcript, createdAt, updatedAt, archived … }
  ```
- `hub/session_update`: Change a session: its title, systems, agent, priority, model, chat mode or contextor, or archive it.

  ```text
  (obj{ title?, systems?, agent?, archived?, priority?, notify?, model?, mode?, contextor?, fnMode?, instructions?, citations?, session … }) => obj{ id, title, owner, agent, model?, mode?, contextor?, fnMode?, systems, instructions?, citations?, selection?, participants, forkOf?, fork?, tools, context, suggested?, announcedSystems?, citationsTold?, fixed?, status, transcript, createdAt, updatedAt, archived … }
  ```
- `hub/session_delete`: Delete a session and its messages.

  ```text
  (obj{/* session id */ session: text}) => obj{deleted: bool}
  ```
- `hub/run_background`: Move a running run to the background, so the chat can go on while it works.

  ```text
  (obj{/* run id */ run: text}) => obj{accepted: bool}
  ```
- `hub/turn_undo`: Undo what one message's runs did, where their fns can undo, and take the message out of the chat.

  ```text
  (obj{/* turn id */ turn: text}) => obj{ turn, undone, failed, notUndoable, kept?, session? … }
  ```

Fns for this: fn:fs/read, fn:fs/write, fn:fs/edit, fn:fs/bash.
